title: A9: home computer offline — fixed server reply, switch offered, stop switch still works
description: With the assistant's home computer offline, a new message gets the server's fixed text that the computer is not online, with a way to move the assistant to another computer; settings, memory and the stop switch keep working.
preconditions: Assistant set up; its home computer's worker stopped.

assertions.expected: 助理所在的电脑现在不在线, with an action to use another computer

cleanup: Start the worker again and resume the assistant.
